quote: Supply Agreement, Section 14.2 (Change in Ownership of Customer) ... any change in direct or indirect ownership of more than 50% of Customer's outstanding voting stock "shall be deemed an assignment of this Agreement by Customer and shall require the prior written consent of Supplier."
reason: The memo discusses only the Customer-side restriction: Section 14.2 treats a change of control as an assignment requiring Supplier consent. It never cites Supply Agreement Section 16.1. It never notes that Vantrell may assign without the Company's consent, so it misses the one-sided assignment right. It also never addresses the risk that the sole-source contract could pass to a competitor or other undesirable party.
